m1_s1_boarding.title: Vessel Gangway
m1_s1_boarding.description: Boarding access deck. Rigging safety and watch security details must be inspected immediately.

hotspots.label: Brief with Cadet Kai
hotspots.explanationText: Meet Cadet Kai to receive the vessel deck safety checks overview.

hotspots.label: Rig Safety Netting
hotspots.explanationText: The accommodation ladder safety netting is correctly tensioned and secured. Compliant with SOLAS Chapter II-1 regulations.

objectives.title: Inspect Safety Netting
objectives.description: Ensure the gangway safety netting is rigged correctly to prevent falls.

m1_s2_office.title: Ship Office
m1_s2_office.description: Administration logs verification center. The PSC inspector Kowalski is waiting.

hotspots.label: Talk to Cadet Kai
hotspots.explanationText: Kai reminds you to complete the document desk reviews and OOW logs checks.

hotspots.label: Speak with PSC Inspector
hotspots.explanationText: Kowalski initiates the onboarding audit interview.

hotspots.label: Audit Ship Certificates
hotspots.explanationText: Swipe to approve valid certificates, and reject invalid certificates to identify compliance issues.

hotspots.label: Audit Rest Hours Logbook
hotspots.explanationText: Re-align watchkeeper shift schedules to satisfy the MLC rest hour constraints.

hotspots.label: Discarded Coffee Mug
hotspots.explanationText: Leaving open liquids on logs risks staining official record registries.

objectives.title: Verify Ship Certificates
objectives.description: Swipe to approve Safe Manning and SOLAS certificates on the desk.

objectives.title: Audit Watchkeeper Rest Hours
objectives.description: Align shift timelines to prevent crew fatigue under MLC limits.

m1_s3_bridge.title: Navigation Bridge
m1_s3_bridge.description: Command and communications center. Test bridge alarm panels and safety boundaries.

hotspots.label: Talk to Cadet Kai
hotspots.explanationText: Kai outlines GMDSS Loop Test protocols and fire door verification.

hotspots.label: GMDSS DSC Loop Test
hotspots.explanationText: Initiate a Digital Selective Calling self-test transmission sequence to verify loopback signals.

hotspots.label: Check Fire Doors
hotspots.explanationText: Fire containment doors release automatically from their electromagnetic holdbacks. Complies with SOLAS Chapter II-2 safety boundaries.

objectives.title: Test GMDSS Radio Loop
objectives.description: Test the DSC transceiver to guarantee safety loopback signal receipt.

objectives.title: Verify Automatic Fire Doors
objectives.description: Check if fire containment doors release correctly to block smoke spread.

m1_s4_engine.title: Engine Machinery Space
m1_s4_engine.description: Machinery control compartment. Verify separators and exhaust insulation.

hotspots.label: Final Brief with Cadet Kai
hotspots.explanationText: Kai reviews your walkaround audits and flags Module 1 as successfully completed.

hotspots.label: Audit Oily Water Separator
hotspots.explanationText: Perform the failsafe 3-way valve bilge alarm test loop for MARPOL compliance.

hotspots.label: Oily Rag on Exhaust Pipe
hotspots.explanationText: Combustible rags left on hot machine exhaust lines violate fire prevention policies.

objectives.title: Audit Oily Water Separator
objectives.description: Trigger the 15ppm sensor alarm and confirm failsafe bilge water recirculation.

objectives.title: Final Onboarding Brief
objectives.description: Conclude the walkthrough checks with Cadet Kai in the Engine Room.
